scenes.setting: A temple-like Backlund basement before The Hanged Giant: Mr. A eats his own snapped finger and writes in blood the divine epiphany — 'Found: The Fool that doesn't belong to this era… Adorers and devotees in Backlund' — then prostrates himself, purpose restored

The City of Silver's ancient curse enacted in the spire's hall — parents and siblings must put their own corrupted blood relatives to the sword — while Lovia walks calmly down to three days of Glory Crown cleansing, leaving Colin one parting fact: a teammate died before her two months ago and never turned into an evil spirit
scenes.text_anchor: “I waited there for five days, but he didn’t turn into an evil spirit.”

scenes.setting: Little Sun's star stays steady — success — and Klein drops back into an ice-cold bed; morning brings Feynapotter noodles with his own meat paste, newspapers, and a day planned around a concert or a play, until the doorbell rings
scenes.text_anchor: Warmth is basically gained by vibration…
